The successful intake snapshot then carried v2, while the deployed database validator and immutable intake table require the unchanged success contract version 2026-08-08-v1. The completion RPC rejected the otherwise inspected IMG_4257 record with HTTP 400.
criticalBlocker.repairState: A narrow application candidate separates successful-intake contract versioning from recovery-diagnostic evidence versioning. It adds a regression assertion for both boundaries; no migration, media, provider, Ready, or external-action behavior is changed.
